Effects of Mandatory Energy Efficiency Disclosure in Housing Markets
abstract: Mandatory disclosure policies are increasingly prevalent despite sparse evidence that they improve market outcomes. We study the effects of requiring home sellers to provide buyers with certified audits of residential energy efficiency. Using similar nearby homes as a comparison group, we find this requirement increases price capitalization of energy efficiency and encourages energy-saving residential investments. We present additional evidence characterizing the market failure as symmetrically incomplete information, which is ameliorated by government intervention. More generally, we formalize and provide empirical support for seller ignorance as a motivation for disclosure policies in markets with bilaterally incomplete information about quality.
abstract_zh: 强制性披露政策日益普遍，尽管几乎没有证据表明它们能够改善市场结果。我们研究了要求房屋卖方向买方提供住宅能源效率认证审计报告的效果。以相似的邻近住房作为对照组，我们发现，该要求提高了能源效率的价格资本化程度，并鼓励了节能型住宅投资。我们提供了更多证据，将市场失灵刻画为对称的不完全信息，而政府干预可以改善这一问题。更一般地，我们将卖方的无知形式化，并为其提供实证支持，以此作为在双边信息不完全的质量市场中推行披露政策的一种动机。

title: Not All Nudges are Created Equal: Comparing Social and Pure Informational Nudges
Does Strategic Ability Affect Efficiency? Evidence from Electricity Markets
abstract: Oligopoly models of price competition predict that strategic firms exercise market power and generate inefficiencies. However, heterogeneity in firms’ strategic ability also generates inefficiencies. We study the Texas electricity market where firms exhibit significant heterogeneity in how they deviate from Nash equilibrium bidding. These deviations, in turn, increase the cost of production. To explain this heterogeneity, we embed a cognitive hierarchy model into a structural model of bidding and estimate firms’ strategic sophistication. We find that firm size and manager education affect sophistication. Using the model, we show that mergers which increase sophistication can increase efficiency despite increasing market concentration. (JEL D24, D43, G34, L13, L25, L94)
abstract_zh: 价格竞争的寡头模型预测，具有战略能力的企业会行使市场势力并造成效率损失。然而，企业战略能力的异质性同样会造成效率损失。我们研究得克萨斯州电力市场，该市场中的企业在偏离纳什均衡报价的方式上表现出显著的异质性。这些偏离反过来又提高了生产成本。为解释这种异质性，我们将认知层级模型嵌入到报价的结构模型中，并估计企业的战略成熟度。我们发现，企业规模和管理者教育水平会影响战略成熟度。利用该模型，我们表明，能够提升战略成熟度的并购，即便会提高市场集中度，也可能提高效率。（JEL D24, D43, G34, L13, L25, L94）

title: Cash for Corollas: When Stimulus Reduces Spending

Power to Choose? An Analysis of Consumer Inertia in the Residential Electricity Market
abstract: Many jurisdictions around the world have deregulated utilities and opened retail markets to competition. However, inertial decision making can diminish consumer benefits of retail competition. Using household-level data from the Texas residential electricity market, we document evidence of consumer inertia. We estimate an econometric model of retail choice to measure two sources of inertia: search frictions/inattention and a brand advantage that consumers afford the incumbent. We find that households rarely search for alternative retailers, and when they do search, households attach a brand advantage to the incumbent. Counterfactual experiments show that low-cost information interventions can notably increase consumer surplus. (JEL D12, D83, L81, L94, L98, M31)
abstract_zh: 许多司法辖区已放松对公用事业的管制，并向竞争开放零售市场。然而，惯性决策可能削弱零售竞争给消费者带来的好处。利用得克萨斯州住宅电力市场的家庭层面数据，我们记录了消费者惯性的证据。我们估计了一个零售选择的计量经济学模型，以衡量两种惯性来源：搜寻摩擦/注意力不足，以及消费者赋予在位企业的品牌优势。我们发现，家庭很少搜寻替代零售商；而当他们进行搜寻时，会赋予在位企业品牌优势。反事实实验表明，低成本的信息干预可以显著提高消费者剩余。（JEL D12, D83, L81, L94, L98, M31）

Efficient Retail Pricing in Electricity and Natural Gas Markets
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: A long line of research investigates whether the retail prices of electricity and natural gas send proper signals about scarcity in order to induce efficient consumption. Historically, regulated utilities have not designed tariffs that set marginal prices equal to marginal costs. Currently, some jurisdictions are opening the retail sectors to competition via “retail choice.” These new regimes replace imperfect regulation with imperfect competition as the process by which retail tariffs are formed. We discuss the challenges in evaluating the efficiency of tariffs and present evidence of how pricing has changed in markets with retail choice.
abstract_zh: 长期以来，大量研究探讨电力和天然气的零售价格是否发出了关于稀缺性的恰当信号，以诱导有效率的消费。历史上，受管制的公用事业公司并未设计出使边际价格等于边际成本的电价方案。目前，部分司法辖区正通过“零售选择”（retail choice）向竞争开放零售市场。这些新制度以不完全竞争取代了不完全管制，成为零售电价的形成过程。我们讨论了评估电价效率所面临的挑战，并提供了零售选择市场中定价如何变化的证据。

Understanding Strategic Bidding in Multi-Unit Auctions: A Case Study of the Texas Electricity Spot Market
abstract: We examine the bidding behavior of firms in the Texas electricity spot market, where bidders submit hourly supply schedules to sell power. We characterize an equilibrium model of bidding and use detailed firm-level data on bids and marginal costs to compare actual bidding behavior to theoretical benchmarks. Firms with large stakes in the market performed close to the theoretical benchmark of static profit maximization. However, smaller firms utilized excessively steep bid schedules significantly deviating from this benchmark. Further analysis suggests that payoff scale has an important effect on firms' willingness and ability to participate in complex, strategic market environments.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了得克萨斯州电力现货市场中企业的报价行为，在该市场中，投标人以小时为单位提交供电报价表。我们刻画了报价的均衡模型，并利用企业层面关于报价和边际成本的详细数据，将实际报价行为与理论基准进行比较。在市场中占有较大份额的企业，其表现接近静态利润最大化的理论基准。然而，规模较小的企业则采用了过于陡峭的报价曲线，显著偏离了该基准。进一步的分析表明，收益规模对企业参与复杂的战略市场环境的意愿和能力具有重要影响。

title: Pricing and Firm Conduct in California's Deregulated Electricity Market
abstract: This paper analyzes the pricing behavior of electricity generating firms in the restructured California market from its inception in April 1998 until its collapse in late 2000. Using detailed firm-level data, I find that conduct is fairly consistent with a Cournot pricing game for much of the sample. In summer and fall 2000, the market was slightly less competitive, yet the dramatic rise in prices was more driven by changes in costs and demand than by changes in firm conduct. The five large nonutility generators raised prices slightly above unilateral market-power levels in 2000, but fell far short of colluding on the joint monopoly price.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了加州重组后的电力市场自1998年4月启动至2000年底崩溃期间，发电企业的定价行为。利用详细的企业层面数据，我发现，在样本的大部分时段内，企业的行为与古诺定价博弈基本一致。2000年夏季和秋季，市场竞争性略有下降，但价格的急剧上涨更多是由成本和需求变化驱动，而非企业行为的改变。五家大型非公用事业发电企业在2000年将价格略微提高至单边市场势力水平之上，但远未达到共同垄断价格的合谋水平。
